subject: [CRIT] True fault on Lab-Power - L07351
body:
Omar Haddad, log L07351 is a TRUE fault (risk 99%).

Recommended: Emergency repair: breaker tripped twice on Lab-Power by Power Systems Engineer Omar Haddad.
